insights.concise_text: The best accuracy of 69.3% from support vector machines with radial basis function kernel was obtained using fine tuning of model parameters using grid search.

insights.concise_text: The classification system used n-grams, bag-of-words, common words and hashtags, and N-grams with support vector machines with radial basis function kernel yielded 68.5% accuracy.
